c.h: Shorthand for the 𦥑 and 爻 components in the traditional character 學.

学.o: Simplified form of 學. Depicts two hands (𦥑) teaching a child (子) under a roof (宀). 爻 represents the sound.
w: to study at the same school; fellow student
x: 我妹妹什么都学我。
Wǒ mèimèi shénme dōu xué wǒ.
My little sister likes to copy everything I do.
他在家说方言，在学校说普通话。
Tā zài jiā shuō fāngyán, zài xuéxiào shuō pǔtōnghuà.
He speaks the local dialect at home and Standard Mandarin at school.
学生身边带着手机。
Xuéshēng shēnbiān dài zhe shǒujī.
The students have mobile phones with them.

給.o: Phonosemantic compound. 糹 represents the meaning and 合 represents the sound.

實.o: Depicts a string of money (貫) under a roof (宀). Based on the original meaning "rich; plentiful". The meaning later expanded to "solid", "fruit", and "true".

哦.o: Phonosemantic compound. 口 represents the meaning and 我 represents the sound.
x: 好好玩，但小心点哦。
Hǎohǎo wán, dàn xiǎoxīn diǎn o.
Have fun and be careful.
哦，原来他是个医生。
Ò, yuánlái tā shì gè yīshēng.
Oh, so he's a doctor.

並.o: Depicts two people standing (立) side by side.

车.o: Pictograph of a war chariot. The simplified character 车 was adapted from the cursive form of the traditional character 車.
w: to pull up (stop one's vehicle); to park
x: 街上一辆车都没有。
Jiē shàng yī liàng chē dōu méiyǒu.
There is not even one car on the street.
我们的汽车尾巴被撞坏了。
Wǒmen de qìchē wěiba bèi zhuànghuài le.
The rear end of our car was smashed.
禁止外来车辆停放。
Jìnzhǐ wàilái chēliàng tíngfàng.
Reserved parking.

带.o: Simplified form of 帶. Pictograph of a woven belt.
w: to bring; to bring about; to produce
to spur; to provide impetus; to drive
to carry (on one's person); to support
x: 带我走。
Dài wǒ zǒu.
Take me away.
这是由我家乡带来的好茶，你品尝一下。
Zhè shì yóu wǒ jiāxiāng dàilái de hǎo chá, nǐ pǐncháng yīxià.
This is a good kind of tea from my hometown. Try it.
把他带走。
Bǎ tā dàizǒu.
Take him away.

度.o: Phonosemantic compound. 又 represents the meaning (using a hand to measure something) and 石 represents the sound.
w: to pass; to spend (time); to survive
x: 红酒酒精十几度。
Hóngjiǔ jiǔjīng shí jǐ dù.
Red wine is around 10% alcohol.
谢天谢地，他的病没到这个程度。
Xiètiānxièdì, tā de bìng méi dào zhè ge chéngdù.
Thank goodness his sickness has not reached this degree.
我的态度是同意和支持。
Wǒ de tàidù shì tóngyì hé zhīchí.
I am in agreement and will lend support.

警.o: Phonosemantic compound. 言 represents the meaning and 敬 represents the sound.
x: 警察用武力驱赶示威者。
Jǐngchá yòng wǔlì qūgǎn shìwēizhě.
The police cleared out the demonstrators by force.
街上躺着个死人，这不警察刚到。
Jiē shang tǎngzhe gè sǐrén, zhè bù jǐngchá gāng dào.
A dead person is lying on the road, and the police has just arrived.

辦.o: Phonosemantic compound. 力 represents the meaning and 辡 represents the sound.

书.o: Simplified form of 書. Phonosemantic compound. 聿 represents the meaning and 者 represents the sound. The simplified character 书 is derived from the cursive form of 書.
w: to read a book; to study; to attend school
secretary (chief official of a branch of a socialist or communist…
x: 我对这本书产生了共鸣。
Wǒ duì zhè běn shū chǎnshēng le gòngmíng.
I resonated with this book.
有人认为读书无用。
Yǒurén rènwéi dúshū wúyòng.
Some believe reading is a waste of time.
麻烦您帮我接通书记办公室的电话，好吗？
Máfan nín bāng wǒ jiētōng shūjì bàngōngshì de diànhuà, hǎo ma?
Could you please connect me to the secretary's office?

試.o: Phonosemantic compound. 言 represents the meaning and 式 represents the sound.

c.h: 纟 is a component form of 糸.

约.o: Simplified form of 約. Phonosemantic compound. 纟 represents the meaning and 勺 represents the sound. Based on the original meaning "bind". The meaning later shifted to "agreement", "restrain", "keep under control", "appointment", and "approximately".
w: to sign a contract or agreement
x: 我想约你明天一起去吃饭，不知道你有没有时间。
Wǒ xiǎng yuē nǐ míngtiān yīqǐ qù chīfàn, bù zhīdào nǐ yǒu méiyǒu shíjiān.
I'd like to invite you out to have a meal tomorrow, if you have the time.
我中午有个约会。
Wǒ zhōngwǔ yǒu ge yuēhuì.
I have a date at noon.

啦.o: Phonosemantic compound. 口 represents the meaning and 拉 represents the sound.
x: 她和他出去？门都没有啦。
Tā hé tā chūqù? Mén dōu méiyǒu la.
She goes out with him? Not a chance.
老师不在，你们就造反啦！
Lǎoshī bùzài, nǐmen jiù zàofǎn la!
If the teacher wasn't here, you'd all just mess around!

另.o: Variant of 冎. Pictograph of bones. Based on the original meaning "bones". The meaning later shifted to "separate", "other" and "another".
w: on the other hand; another aspect
(to do sth) separately; as a separate action
to treat differently; another cup of tea
x: 一个经历过失恋的人还会爱上另外的人吗？
Yīge jīnglì guò shīliàn de rén hái huì àishàng lìngwài de rén ma?
Can someone who has been disappointed in love fall for someone else?
这个问题很复杂，另外我觉得它一定还有其他的因素。
Zhège wèntí hěn fùzá, lìngwài wǒ juéde tā yīdìng hái yǒu qítā de yīnsù.
This issue is very complicated. In addition, I think it must have a lot of other factors.

c.h: ⺼ is a component form of 肉.

腦.o: Phonosemantic compound. ⺼ represents the meaning and 𡿺 represents the sound.

武.o: Depicts marching (止) with a weapon (戈).
w: military skill or technique (in former times)
x: 在这件事情上，你为什么这么武断？
Zài zhè jiàn shìqíng shàng, nǐ wèishénme zhème wǔduàn?
Why are you so arbitrary regarding this matter?
武则天是中国历史唯一一个女皇。
Wǔ Zétiān shì zhōngguó lìshǐ wéiyī yīge nǚhuáng.
Wu Zetian is the only female emperor in Chinese history.

c.h: Added later when the character started to mean "not" and to distinguish from 不.

否.o: Originally the same character as 不. Distinguishing component 口 was added later to the character when it took on the meaning "not". 不 represents the sound.
w: whether (or not); if; is or isn't
whether or not; can it or can't it
to declare to be untrue; to deny
to negate; to deny; to reject
x: 不知您是否有时间。
Bùzhī nín shìfǒu yǒu shíjiān.
I wonder if you might have time.
赶快停止你的动作，否则我们要开枪了！
Gǎnkuài tíngzhǐ nǐ de dòngzuò, fǒuzé wǒmen yào kāiqiāng le!
Stop what you are doing or we'll open fire!
你现在有时间吗，可否帮我一个忙？
Nǐ xiànzài yǒu shíjiān ma, kěfǒu bāng wǒ yī ge máng?
Are you free now? Can you do me a favor?

烦.o: Depicts fire (火) in the head (页), i.e. a headache. Simplified form of 煩.
w: to be worried; to be distressed; worries
to feel agitated; to be troubled
to create difficulties; to invite trouble
bored; fed up with sth; sick of sth
x: 你不要烦我好吗？
Nǐ bùyào fán wǒ hǎo ma?
Don't annoy me, okay?
他发现自己有麻烦了。
Tā fāxiàn zìjǐ yǒu máfan le.
He found himself in a jam.
他太烦人了。
Tā tài fánrén le.
He is too annoying.

甦.o: Being reborn is to grant an additional (更) life (生).

c.h: Shorthand for the 𦰋 component in the traditional character 夢.

梦.o: Simplified form of 夢. Depicts a person with an emphasized eye (𦰋) sleeping on a bed (爿), conveying the meaning "dream". 𦰋 also represents the sound. The 爿 (bed) component was later reanalyzed as meaning component 夕 (evening).
w: to dream; to have a dream; fig. illusion
to dream about (sth or sb); to see in a dream
x: 我有一个梦。
Wǒ yǒu yīge mèng.
I have a dream.
噩梦一般！
Èmèng yībān!
It was a nightmare!

c.h: 艹 is a component form of 艸.

苦.o: Phonosemantic compound. 艹 represents the meaning and 古 represents the sound.
w: to force a smile; a bitter laugh
x: 辛苦大家了！
Xīnkǔ dàjiā le!
Thanks, everyone, for your trouble!
你辛苦了！
Nǐ xīnkǔ le!
Thanks for your trouble!

c.h: 亻 is a component form of 人.

伦.o: Phonosemantic compound. 亻 represents the meaning and 仑 represents the sound. Simplified form of 倫.
x: 她的美丽确是无与伦比。
Tā de měilì quèshì wúyǔlúnbǐ.
Her beauty is beyond compare.
伦敦是英国的首都。
Lúndūn shì Yīngguó de shǒudū.
London is the capital of England.

左.o: Pictograph of a left hand. The 工 (work) component was added later to represent the meaning "help; assist", now written as 佐.
w: left; the left side; to the left of
x: 你想左了。
Nǐ xiǎng zuǒ le.
You are mistaken.
他身高可能在三米左右。
Tā shēngāo kěnéng zài sān mǐ zuǒyòu.
He was about three meters tall.
我估计温度都在十度左右吧。
Wǒ gūjì wēndù dōu zài shí dù zuǒyòu ba.
I guess the temperature is around ten degrees now.

麦.o: Simplified form of 麥. The top component 來 depicts a stalk of wheat. The bottom component depicts roots.
x: 面粉是小麦做的粉。
Miànfěn shì xiǎomài zuò de fěn.
Flour is a powder made from wheat.

艦.o: Phonosemantic compound. 舟 represents the meaning and 監 represents the sound.

c.h: Indicates the location of the armpits.

亦.o: Pictograph of a person, with two dots at the armpits. Based on the original meaning "armpit", now written as 腋. The current meaning is a phonetic loan.
w: lit. isn't that a joy? (quote from Confucius)
x: 天若有情天亦老。
Tiān ruò yǒu qíng tiān yì lǎo.
If Heaven had feelings, Heaven too would grow old.

婦.o: Depicts a woman (女) using a broom (帚). Women were traditionally responsible for household chores in ancient times. 帚 also represents the sound.

坦.o: Phonosemantic compound. 土 represents the meaning and 旦 represents the sound.
w: to say candidly; to acknowledge frankly
x: 他在斯坦福教了十年学。
Tā zài Sītǎnfú jiāo le shínián xué.
He taught at Stanford University for ten years.

瓦.o: Pictograph of an object related to pottery.
w: to collapse; to disintegrate; to crumble
x: 他的婚姻瓦解了。
Tā de hūnyīn wǎjiě le.
His marriage fell apart.

旦.o: Depicts the sun (日) rising above the horizon (一) at dawn. In Oracle script the bottom component was the phonetic 丁, which was later reanalyzed as the earth or a horizon.
w: role of vivacious young female in Chinese opera
overnight until daybreak (idiom); all night long
x: 他毕业于复旦大学。
Tā bìyè yú Fùdàn Dàxué.
He graduated from Fudan University.

鞦.o: Phonosemantic compound. 革 represents the meaning and 秋 represents the sound.
w: spring and autumn; four seasons; year
swing (seat hung from a frame or branch)

c.h: ⺮ is a component form of 竹.

符.o: Phonosemantic compound. ⺮ represents the meaning and 付 represents the sound.
w: in keeping with; in accordance with
x: 它未必符合我们的国情。
Tā wèibì fúhé wǒmen de guóqíng.
It may not conform to our national conditions.
很抱歉，您要办的事不符合规定，我们不能办理。
Hěn bàoqiàn, nín yào bàn de shì bù fúhé guīdìng, wǒmen bù néng bànlǐ.
I'm sorry, we cannot process your request as it does not meet the requirements.

触.g: knock against, touch, to butt with the horns

c.h: Shorthand for the phonetic 蜀 component in the traditional character 觸.

触.o: Simplified form of 觸. Phonosemantic compound. 角 represents the meaning and 蜀 represents the sound.
w: to touch; to stir up (trouble or emotions)
x: 我在这里接触了这么多的新鲜事物，我真是大开眼界。
Wǒ zài zhèlǐ jiēchù le zhème duō de xīnxiān shìwù, wǒ zhēnshì dàkāiyǎnjiè.
I have come into contact with so many new things here — it's been really eye-opening.
请勿触摸。
Qǐng wù chùmō.
Please do not touch.

c.h: ⻏ is a component form of 邑.

邦.o: Phonosemantic compound. ⻏ represents the meaning and 丰 represents the sound.
x: 中国和日本是一衣带水的邻邦。
Zhōngguó hé Rìběn shì yīyīdàishuǐ de línbāng.
China and Japan are neighbouring countries separated only by a narrow strip of water.
澳大利亚有三级政府：联邦政府、州政府和地方政府。
Àodàlìyà yǒu sān jí zhèngfǔ: liánbāng zhèngfǔ, zhōu zhèngfǔ hé dìfāng zhèngfǔ.
Australia has three levels of government: federal, state and local.

w: to investigate a crime; to scout
x: 我弟弟喜欢看侦探小说。
Wǒ dìdi xǐhuan kàn zhēntàn xiǎoshuō.
My younger brother likes reading detective novels.
警察很快就侦破了这个案子。
Jǐngchá hěn kuài jiù zhēnpò le zhège ànzi.
The police solved the case very quickly.

c.h: 氵 is a component form of 水.

润.o: Phonosemantic compound. 氵 represents the meaning and 闰 represents the sound. Simplified form of 潤.
x: 请大家指点如何润去加拿大？
Qǐng dàjiā zhǐdiǎn rúhé rùn qù Jiānádà?
Can people give suggestions on how to emigrate to Canada?
由于上季度的利润丰厚，公司为她发了不少奖金。
Yóuyú shàng jìdù de lìrùn fēnghòu, gōngsī wèi tā fā le bùshǎo jiǎngjīn.
Because of the huge profit last quarter, the company gave her a lot of bonuses.
哈人，我先润了。
Hārén, wǒ xiān rùn le.
That's scary. I'm gonna run away.

c.h: Evolved from 𰆍 during the Western Zhou period.
This was added to 𰆍 later to reinforce the meaning.

禦.o: Phonosemantic compound. 示 represents the meaning and 御 represents the sound. Originally 𰆍.
禦.om: ritual sacrifice to ward off calamities

礦.o: Phonosemantic compound. 石 represents the meaning and 廣 represents the sound.

w: pre-Qin, Chinese history up to the foundation of the Qin imperial…
serve Qin in the morning Chu in the evening (idiom); quick to…
x: 秦原是周朝的一个诸侯国。
Qín yuánshì Zhōucháo de yī ge zhūhóuguó.
Qin was originally a vassal state of the Zhou dynasty.

c.h: 扌 is a component form of 手.

擦.o: Phonosemantic compound. 扌 represents the meaning and 察 represents the sound.
w: brief encounter; to brush past sb
to clean (with water or alcohol); to swab
x: 我用湿抹布擦桌子。
Wǒ yòng shī mǒbù cā zhuōzǐ.
I wash the table with a wet cloth.
擦边是短视频爆火的密码之一。
Cābiān shì duǎnshìpín bàohuǒ de mìmǎ zhīyī.
Provocative content is one of the key factors to making short videos go viral.

c.h: 讠 is a component form of 言.

详.o: Phonosemantic compound. 讠 represents the meaning and 羊 represents the sound. Simplified form of 詳.
w: not in detail; not quite clear
what's frequently heard can be repeated in detail (idiom)
x: 他们详细讨论了这件事，结果达成谅解。
Tāmen xiángxì tǎolùn le zhè jiàn shì, jiéguǒ dáchéng liàngjiě.
They discussed the matter in detail, and finally came to an understanding.
生卒年不详。
Shēngzúnián bùxiáng.
Dates of birth and death are unknown.

账.o: Phonosemantic compound. 贝 represents the meaning and 长 represents the sound. Simplified form of 賬.
w: to pay the bill; to settle accounts
x: 服务员！结账！
Fúwùyuán! Jiézhàng!
Waiter! The bill, please!
钱到账。
Qián dàozhàng.
The funds have reached the account.

c.h: 釒 is a component form of 金.

釦.o: Phonosemantic compound. 釒 represents the meaning and 口 represents the sound.

c.h: 攵 is a component form of 攴.

敦.o: Phonosemantic compound. 享 represents the meaning and 攵 represents the sound. Simplified form of 㪟.
w: to press; to urge; to hasten
x: 伦敦是英国的首都。
Lúndūn shì Yīngguó de shǒudū.
London is the capital of England.

姦.o: Someone who flirts with many women 女

c.h: 灬 is a component form of 火.

焦.o: Originally a pictograph of a wren. Based on the original meaning "wren", now written as 鷦. Later used as a phonetic loan for "burn", after which the fire (灬) component was added.
w: lit. badly burned about the head (from trying to put out a fire)…
x: 为了赶在年底完成这项目，团队最近是忙得焦头烂额。
Wèile gǎn zài niándǐ wánchéng zhè xiàngmù, tuánduì zuìjìn shì máng dé jiāotóulàn'é.
In order to finish the project before the end of this year, our team has been overwhelmingly busy recently.
我一拍了照片，她就立即成为众人瞩目的焦点。
Wǒ yī pāi le zhàopiàn, tā jiù lìjí chéngwéi zhòngrén zhǔmù de jiāodiǎn.
As soon as I took a picture, she ran towards the limelight.

韦.o: Simplified form of 韋. Pictograph of feet walking around city walls. The character is based on the original meaning "to surround". The "leather" meaning is a phonetic loan.
x: 韦老师来自广西。
Wéi lǎoshī láizì Guǎngxī.
Teacher Wei comes from Guangxi.
小韦每天骑车上班。
Xiǎo Wéi měi tiān qí chē shàngbān.
Xiao Wei cycles to work every day.

賦.o: Money 貝 used to raise an army 武; 武 also provides the pronunciation

瘦.o: Phonosemantic compound. 疒 represents the meaning and 叟 represents the sound.
w: to waste away; to become thin
as thin as a match; emaciated (idiom)
x: 他瘦了五公斤。
Tā shòu le wǔ gōngjīn.
He lost five kilograms.
儿子很瘦削，说屁股痒，是不是有虫了？
Érzi hěn shòuxuē, shuō pìgu yǎng, shìbùshì yǒu chóng le?
(My) son's gotten skinny, says his bottom is itchy, has he got worms?

c.h: 扌 is a component form of 手.

拦.o: Phonosemantic compound. 扌 represents the meaning and 兰 represents the sound. Simplified form of 攔.
w: to stop; to bar the way
to intercept at the net (volleyball, tennis etc)
to block sb's path; to waylay
x: 他们一直拦着我。
Tāmen yìzhí lán zhe wǒ.
They keep holding me back.
他们一直拦著我。
Tāmen yìzhí lán zhe wǒ.
They keep holding me back.

錦.o: Silk 帛 inlaid with gold 釒; 釒 also provides the pronunciation

锦.o: Silk 帛 inlaid with gold 钅; 钅 also provides the pronunciation
w: lit. on brocade, add flowers (idiom); to decorate sth already perfect
x: 他真是绣口锦心，句句都美得像诗。
Tā zhēn shì xiùkǒujǐnxīn, jù jù dōu měi dé xiàng shī.
He truly has an eloquent tongue and a poetic mind — every line he writes is like poetry.

倦.o: A curled-up 卷 person 亻; 卷 also provides the pronunciation
w: to be weary of; to be fed up with; tedious
lit. diligent and never slacking (idiom); continuous concentrated…
instructing with tireless zeal (idiom, from Analects)
x: 工作了一天，他感到很疲倦。
Gōngzuò le yī tiān, tā gǎndào hěn píjuàn.
After working all day, he felt very tired.
他厌倦了每天加班的生活。
Tā yànjuàn le měi tiān jiābān de shēnghuó.
He has grown tired of a life of working overtime every day.

c.h: 忄 is a component form of 心.

悦.o: Phonosemantic compound. 忄 represents the meaning and 兑 represents the sound. Simplified form of 悅.
w: warms the heart and delights the eye (idiom)
x: 听音乐让人心情愉悦。
Tīng yīnyuè ràng rén xīnqíng yúyuè.
Listening to music puts people in a cheerful mood.

c.h: 艹 is a component form of 艸.

薦.o: Depicts an animal (廌) eating grass (艹) in a pasture. Based on the original meaning "pasture, straw mat". The current meaning is a phonetic loan.

蝦.o: Phonosemantic compound. 虫 represents the meaning and 叚 represents the sound.

c.h: 钅 is a component form of 金.

钦.o: Phonosemantic compound. 钅 represents the meaning and 欠 represents the sound. Simplified form of 欽.
w: to admire; to look up to
compiled and published by Imperial command
to admire; to hold in high esteem
x: 我很钦佩他的勇气。
Wǒ hěn qīnpèi tā de yǒngqì.
I really admire his courage.
她的努力令人钦佩。
Tā de nǔlì lìngrénqīnpèi.
Her hard work is admirable.

c.h: 氵 is a component form of 水.

浦.o: Phonosemantic compound. 氵 represents the meaning and 甫 represents the sound.
x: 浦东是上海的一个区。
Pǔdōng shì Shànghǎi de yī gè qū.
Pudong is a district of Shanghai.
弓弦不能不绷紧。
